why_russia_detail.title: Why Russia Market? | E-Commerce and Export Analysis
why_russia_detail.desc_meta: Analysis of the Russian e-commerce market volume, the power of platforms like Ozon and Wildberries, and the high demand for Turkish textile brands.
why_russia_detail.subtitle: Discover why the Russian market is the most strategic growth area for Turkish brands and manufacturers in the light of changing balances in global trade and the new rules of e-commerce.
why_russia_detail.volume_title: Massive Market Volume and Fast Growth
why_russia_detail.volume_p1: Russia, with its massive population exceeding 140 million, is one of the largest consumer markets not only in its region but in the world. In a country where internet penetration exceeds 85%, there are over 100 million users shopping online.
why_russia_detail.volume_p2: During and after the pandemic, the habit of online shopping grew exponentially, and today the e-commerce market volume has exceeded 100 billion dollars. The coverage areas of giant marketplaces such as Wildberries, Ozon, and Lamoda, expanding even to the most remote regions of the country, have carried daily order numbers to millions.
why_russia_detail.volume_li2: Millions of package shipments on average every day
why_russia_detail.volume_li3: Record-high use of digital payment systems instead of cash
why_russia_detail.demand_p1: The withdrawal of global giants and many European brands from the market created the need to fill a massive gap. Although there is a density of Chinese products, the concept of “Made in Türkiye” has always had a premium perception to the Russian consumer in terms of quality, stitching patterns, and design harmony.
why_russia_detail.demand_p2: Compared to Asian products, the high standards of Turkish goods and a style close to the European school are among the top choices of consumers. Turkish brands have serious credibility in many categories such as textiles, cosmetics, home electronics, and home living.
why_russia_detail.demand_li1: Turkey's unique advantage on the Quality/Price axis
why_russia_detail.demand_li2: High capability in fast fashion and design
why_russia_detail.demand_li3: Familiarity with the Turkish brand perception established for years through suitcase trade (B2B)
why_russia_detail.logistics_p1: The success of e-commerce in a country with the largest geography in the world like Russia depends on the logistics ecosystem. Russia solved this problem with the PVZ (Order Pick-up Points) model.
why_russia_detail.logistics_p2: Today there are more than 80,000 delivery points across the country. The consumer places an order, directs their package to the nearest PVZ point, tries the products in the fitting rooms there, and only buys them if they are sure they fit or if they like them.
why_russia_detail.logistics_li1: Consumer confidence to fill the cart thanks to the "Try and Buy" system
why_russia_detail.logistics_li2: Elimination of the obligation to wait for the courier at home
why_russia_detail.competition_p1: Competing successfully as a new brand in the European market (Amazon, Zalando, etc.) today requires a very costly advertising budget and fighting within low profitability margins. The market is saturated, and the players are established.
why_russia_detail.competition_p2: On the other hand, in the Russian market, with a properly established Consignment model, transparent tax management, and the right marketing plan, it is much easier to reach high sales volumes and capture strong profit margins in foreign currency.
why_russia_detail.competition_li1: Rapid digitalization of the Russian market against Europe's 5%-10% growth
why_russia_detail.competition_li2: Effective ranking algorithms so your brand is not lost among giants
why_russia_detail.competition_li3: Original and licensed Turkish production perception generating direct sales closures
why_russia_detail.cta_desc: Let us connect you to this massive market with our risk-free consignment operation model. Let's design your strategy together.

home.faq_desc: The most curious questions about entering the Russian market.
home.faq1_q: Can you sell on Ozon from Turkey?
home.faq1_a: Yes, you can directly sell via the Ozon Global C-B (Cross-Border) model through your company based in Turkey. For stronger and faster growth, setting up a company in Russia and positioning yourself as a local seller in the market with the B2C (Consignment) model is the most efficient method.
home.faq2_q: Can Turkish brands sell on Wildberries?
home.faq2_a: Turkish brands cannot sell individually on Wildberries directly from Turkey. Wildberries requires local warehouses and operations. Therefore, you must either partner with an end-to-end partner in Russia or set up a local company. By taking over your logistics and operations, we put your brand directly on Wildberries Russia shelves.
home.faq3_q: Do you need to set up a company to do e-commerce in Russia?
home.faq3_a: If you are shipping wholesale or only from Global marketplaces (border out), a company is not required. However, if you want to directly enter marketplaces like Wildberries and Lamoda, establish a warehouse, and make profitable direct B2C sales, a local presence is required.
home.faq4_q: What is the EAC certificate and for which products is it required?
home.faq4_a: The EAC certificate (Eurasian Economic Union conformity document) is mandatory for customs entry and marketplaces in many categories such as textiles, electronics, and cosmetics. It works just like the CE certificate in Europe. When you work with us, you get end-to-end support for certification consulting.
